fields.name: Querying
fields.responsibility: Holds how a data method runs against a non-sharded database: naming the SQL to execute and how to invoke it, building the parameter set for it, executing it through the single resilient execution path, running ordered steps atomically as a batch, and exposing configured databases as read and write endpoints. These belong together because they are the path every non-sharded call travels from caller to result; it mirrors the Querying section of the documentation.
